authority: R-167 v1.8 is an additive T0 route reduction. It proves exact exhaustion compatibility for every fixed finite split-product level, an exact sandwiched-Renyi sufficient condition for the missing two-orientation history tail, the zero-temperature OS temporal-mass/GNS-gap equivalence, the exact one-site Q3 instanton action minimum, and a conditional low-doublet Ising reference gap. It also proves that the registered entropy, finite-moment, and two-sided energy-form controls do not automatically imply the required Renyi estimate, and that the direct two-phase Yarotsky import lacks its load-bearing hypotheses. The actual all-exhaustion common alpha, actual Q3 history estimate, beta-infinity phase selection, actual broken-sector temporal mass, continuum, physical reference comparison, prospective validation, Sector A, and Pre-A remain open.

fixed_trotter_level_compatibility.theorem: For A supported in a finite X and every fixed split-product word containing b bond layers, onsite factors preserve support and each exact commuting all-bond layer enlarges support by at most one lattice halo. The word therefore lies in the multiplier algebra of N_b(X) and agrees exactly in every finite ambient volume containing that halo. The same statement holds for adjoints and the reverse-sign inverse word.
fixed_trotter_level_compatibility.exact_all_bond_identity: All cross-bond generators are multiplication polynomials in q and commute exactly, including bonds sharing a vertex. Their exponential factorization is an exact finite-volume identity.
fixed_trotter_level_compatibility.scope: This is a theorem at each fixed finite Trotter level only. It proves neither n-to-infinity Cauchy convergence nor a continuous group, generator, product-star-inverse completion, common KMS quotient, global strict topology, or invariance of a local Weyl or resolvent C-star algebra.

renyi_history_sufficiency.setup: For alpha>1 put theta=(alpha-1)/alpha. Let rho be faithful and P any unitary partial split history in either orientation.
renyi_history_sufficiency.projection_bound: With Qtilde_alpha(P rho P*||rho)=||rho^(-theta/2) P rho^(1/2)||_(2alpha)^(2alpha), every projection E obeys Tr(P rho P* E)<=Qtilde_alpha^(1/alpha) Tr(rho E)^theta. Uniform control of P and P* gives the exact two-orientation sum bound 2 Q_(alpha,T)^(1/alpha) rho(E)^theta.
renyi_history_sufficiency.weighted_tail: If rho(max_(x in S)|q_x|>u)<=M_a|S|exp(-a u^2), then each history orientation has fourth tail bounded by Q^(1/alpha)(M_a|S|)^theta exp(-bL^2)(L^4+2L^2/b+2/b^2), b=theta a. The coordinate-cutoff bond tail satisfies |w_(xy,L)|^2<=4c^2 X_(xy)^4 1_(X_(xy)>L).
renyi_history_sufficiency.corridor: With L=R^gamma and 0<gamma<1/2, a squared-seminorm history multiplier exp(kappa_T L^2) is absorbed when theta(a-d)>kappa_T if the sandwiched divergence is at most dL^2+o(L^2). If the same multiplier is paid after taking the square root, require theta(a-d)>2kappa_T.
renyi_history_sufficiency.scope: This is a sufficient reduction. No uniform Q3LOCK sandwiched-Renyi or direct restricted-tail domination theorem is proved.

renyi_energy_form_no_go.fixture: A two-level Gibbs family has vanishing relative entropy and energy excess, uniformly bounded prescribed finite tilted moments, all-coefficient Gaussian reference moments, and the two-sided comparison (1/2)K<=UKU*<=2K, while every fixed-alpha>1 sandwiched Renyi divergence tends to infinity.
renyi_energy_form_no_go.consequence: The current energy-form, entropy, and finite-moment inputs do not automatically imply the history hypothesis in renyi_history_sufficiency.
renyi_energy_form_no_go.scope: This rejects only the automatic implication. It is not a Q3LOCK dynamics counterexample and does not prove that a stronger model-specific quasi-invariance estimate is impossible.

zero_temperature_os_gap_equivalence.hypotheses: In a selected zero-temperature phase let H>=0 have simple vacuum kernel and let centered vectors from an invariant observable core form a form core for H^(1/2) on the vacuum complement.
zero_temperature_os_gap_equivalence.equivalence: A spectral gap Delta, the phasewise coercive inequality -i hbar omega(A*delta(A))>=Delta[omega(A*A)-|omega(A)|^2], and G_A(tau)<=exp(-Delta tau/hbar)G_A(0) for every core observable are equivalent.
zero_temperature_os_gap_equivalence.mass_test: A common large-time rate G_A(tau)<=C_A exp(-m tau), with finite observable-dependent C_A, implies Delta>=hbar m.
zero_temperature_os_gap_equivalence.scope: This is a zero-temperature criterion. A fixed-beta thermal OS/KMS reconstruction does not by itself provide the positive vacuum Hamiltonian, beta-infinity selection, or the required uniform temporal rate.

q3_instanton_low_doublet_reference.instanton: For the shifted one-site Q3 potential and every absolutely continuous finite-action H1_loc heteroclinic from -v times the all-ones vector to +v times that vector, with chi>0 and v>0, the Euclidean action is at least S_inst=(16 sqrt(2)/3)v^3 sqrt(chi g). The locked kink attains the minimum. For lambda>0 it is unique up to common time translation; for lambda=0 the eight scalar centers may translate independently.
q3_instanton_low_doublet_reference.instanton_scope: The action minimum identifies a semiclassical exponent precursor only. It is not an eigenvalue-splitting or prefactor theorem.
q3_instanton_low_doublet_reference.reference: Condition on simple even and odd one-site singlets with splitting delta_1, high-mode gap Gamma, nonzero m=<phi_0,q_e phi_1>, and residual R_e=q_e-ms. The doublet-Ising reference has exactly two product ground vectors and gap at least min{Gamma,2J kappa(G)}, J=8cm^2. On the periodic cubic bond multigraph kappa(G)=6.
q3_instanton_low_doublet_reference.remainder: The exact full-minus-reference remainder is delta_1 sum P_1 plus (c/2) sum [m{d_s,d_R}+d_R^2]. Rigorous enclosures and a volume-uniform relative-perturbation or block-diagonalization theorem are still missing.
q3_instanton_low_doublet_reference.scope: The displayed gap belongs to the conditional reference Hamiltonian, not the exact Q3LOCK broken-sector GNS representation.

yarotsky_qps_boundary.two_phase_mismatch: The direct two-phase quantum Pirogov-Sinai theorem requires a finite-dimensional onsite reference with two exact product zero vectors, a local gap and Peierls condition, and a sufficiently small relative perturbation. The exact Q3 onsite space is L2(R^8); classical point minima are not Hilbert vectors, the finite quantum onsite ground is unique and positive, and the required doublet reduction and smallness are not established.
yarotsky_qps_boundary.single_phase_nuance: The distinct single-phase relative-form theorem permits infinite-dimensional onsite spaces and can produce an existential unique weak-coupling phase. That is not the ordered broken-phase conclusion sought here.
yarotsky_qps_boundary.ir_boundary: The registered infrared condition is a lower bound on c. It supplies no upper perturbative radius and none of the one-site splitting, high-mode gap, matrix element, or residual-form constants required by the doublet reference.
yarotsky_qps_boundary.scope: This is a direct-import hypothesis mismatch, not a no-go for a future controlled low-doublet theorem and not a counterexample to an actual sector gap.
